title: Names of party officers to be filed.
bodyText: All parties shall submit to the chief election officer and the respective county clerks not later than 4:30 p.m. on the one hundred seventieth day prior to the next primary, a list of names and addresses of officers of the central committee and of the respective county committees.
bodyHtml: §11-64  Names of party officers to be filed.  All parties shall submit to the chief election officer and the respective county clerks not later than 4:30 p.m. on the one hundred seventieth day prior to the next primary, a list of names and addresses of officers of the central committee and of the respective county committees. [L 1970, c 26, pt of §2; am L 1973, c 217, §1(r); am L 1983, c 34, §6; am L 2022, c 4, §3]
